purpose: Primary-source register for dated research notes, not a decipherment certificate
source_check_scope: Named sources were inspected or had the access limitation recorded. This is not an exhaustive review of every current solution claim.
content_policy: Brief attributed paraphrases and links. No manuscript photographs, complete third-party corpus or archival document images republished.

cases.status_scope: Archival recovery and private sale documented; no complete reproducible public method established by the primary pages checked
